rules.sentence: Diagnose Brucellosis by blood or cerebrospinal fluid cultures and treat with doxycycline plus either rifampin or streptomycin; sulfamethoxazole/trimethoprim may be used instead of doxycycline in children.[26]

Diagnose Brucellosis by blood or cerebrospinal fluid cultures and treat with doxycycline plus either rifampin or streptomycin; sulfamethoxazole/trimethoprim may be used instead of doxycycline in children.[26]
The incubation period of Brucellosis ranges from 5 days to 5 months.[Brucellosis - Patients with Suspected Infection. 2012]
Brucellosis begins as a flu-like illness, with headache, fever, and arthralgias.
Patients can develop hepatomegaly, transaminitis, orchitis, epididymitis, endocarditis, and anemia.
Symptoms can become chronic even with treatment.

Neurobrucellosis occurs when meningitis or meningoencephalitis is present and is associated with optic neuritis, cerebellitis, ischemic strokes, myelitis, [23][24] and chronic peripheral neuropathy, radiculopathy, or cranial nerve palsies.[25]
Death occurs in 2% of cases, with endocarditis being the most common cause.
The incubation period is typically 3 to 5 days, ranging from 1 to 21 days.[Tularemia - For Clinicians. 2022]
The symptoms of tularemia include fever, headache, and fatigue, with others dependent on the route of exposure.
